app.title: TrueDose
app.subtitle: Simulation Stage
app.disclaimer: Alexa+ is simulated. MCP server is real. Mock data. Not a medical device.

s1.title: Morning pill
s1.summary: Grandma logs her morning dose. Alexa+ confirms quietly; family is not bothered.

s2.title: Missed dose ladder
s2.summary: Gentle reminder to Grandma first. Calm check-in to Daughter only after grace period. Never emergency calls.

s3.title: Consent-gated gate check
s3.summary: Daughter asks to check the gate. Pipeline pauses for Grandma's voice consent before returning status.

s4.title: Lock with confirm & undo
s4.summary: Physical action requires confirmation and maintains an active 60-second undo window.

s5.title: No grant & voice revoke
s5.summary: Default deny on unauthorized check. Grandma revokes access at any time with immediate effect.

messages.emptyPrompt: Press Play to see the first message.
messages.noMessageNotice: No message sent. Nothing needed family's attention.

consent.question: Allow your daughter to check the gate?
consent.pendingToDaughter: Grandma needs to say yes first.
consent.grantedToDaughter: Grandma said yes. The gate is locked.
consent.declinedToDaughter: Grandma chose not to share that right now.
consent.blockedByDefault: I can't share that without Grandma's permission. Want me to ask her?
consent.confirmation: Lock the front gate now? Reply yes to confirm.
consent.undoOffer: Done. You can undo this for 60 seconds.
consent.revokeDone: Done. She can no longer see that.
consent.nothingToRevoke: There's nothing to stop sharing right now.
consent.reminderToGrandma: Friendly reminder: this morning's pill isn't logged yet.
consent.messageToDaughter: Grandma hasn't logged this morning's pill yet. This is just a check-in, not an emergency.
consent.consentTimeout: Grandma hasn't answered yet. I can ask again later.
